limitations: No authenticated production journey or exploitation.
Actual offline scanner client, provider control-plane permissions, restore and proxy sanitization acceptance remain unavailable.
Full source review does not establish all package advisory exploitability or production acceptance.
scope.runtimeStatus: Read-only live deployment/configuration checks and isolated local builds/tests/migration replay completed. Production mutation and exploitation not performed.
scope.summary: Security component of full Tixmo current-project audit; full API/frontend runtime, test and operational source review under one business per deployment.
scope.validationMode: Source tracing, counterevidence review and harmless exact-parser runtime-config reproduction.

assets: Protected assets include user identities/password hashes/roles and business records in PostgreSQL (tixmoapi2/prisma/schema.prisma:57-94), customer order/ticket ownership and payment state (tixmoapi2/src/api/orders/service.ts:274-278; tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/service.ts:201-249), browser access/refresh tokens in origin-local localStorage keys access_token and refresh_token (tdash/src/lib/session.js:1-4,21-48,89-103), JWT signing keys and refresh revocation timestamps (tixmoapi2/src/utils/jwt.ts:15-46; tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/service.ts:32-33,252-266), scanner API keys stored in PostgreSQL (tixmoapi2/src/api/scanners/service.ts:64-65,98-108,134-161), reviewer bearer tokens and asset-share capabilities (tixmoapi2/src/api/approvals/service.ts:161-168,434-447; tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/service.ts:60-83,729-738), private uploaded media and S3 credentials (tixmoapi2/src/config/s3.ts:4-15; tixmoapi2/src/services/upload.service.ts:74-87), Redis rate-limit/availability/revocation state (tixmoapi2/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts:19-32,66-98; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/waitingRoom.ts:6-19), and credentials/data sent to Stripe, email providers, logs, and Sentry (tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/service.ts:21-65; tixmoapi2/src/config/email.ts:43-59,135-197; tixmoapi2/src/config/logger.ts:36-46; tixmoapi2/src/config/sentry.ts:17-63).
assumptions: No SECURITY.md was found in the repository, its component inventories, or ancestor chain through filesystem root. No authoritative threat model or knowledge base was supplied. This is offline architecture mapping, not completed vulnerability coverage or live deployment verification. Current local .env destination inspection, with credentials omitted, shows PostgreSQL localhost:5432/tixmoapi, Redis localhost:6379 database 0, 7d/30d JWT lifetimes, LOG_TO_FILE=true, and S3 endpoint https://t3.storageapi.dev with bucket mediabucket-0zpraphus3gb0; inherited process environment can override dotenv values (tixmoapi2/.env:7,10,12,16,18,36,40,67; tixmoapi2/src/config/environment.ts:3,51-63; tixmoapi2/src/config/s3.ts:4-15). Local database destinations therefore do not imply isolated external upload storage. Production environment values, reverse-proxy header sanitization/TLS, Docker volume host locations, database/Redis network controls, S3 bucket/IAM policies, backup restoration, and email/Stripe configuration remain unverified. README claims 15min access/7d refresh, whereas executable defaults and local .env use 7d/30d (tixmoapi2/README.md:379; tixmoapi2/src/config/environment.ts:60-63; tixmoapi2/.env:16,18). Vite serves 5173, while CLIENT_URL defaults to 3001 and the local .env has no CLIENT_URL; notification URLs require an override or trusted request-derived origin (tdash/vite.config.js:10-18; tixmoapi2/src/config/environment.ts:49; tixmoapi2/src/services/approval-email.service.ts:40-56). Production runtime-config.js defaults API to /api/v1, but bundled Nginx contains only SPA static routing: a configured absolute API URL or external reverse proxy is required (tdash/docker-entrypoint.d/40-runtime-config.sh:4,20-29; tdash/nginx.site.conf:4-8). Startup validates only DATABASE_URL/JWT_SECRET/JWT_REFRESH_SECRET/SESSION_SECRET; missing Stripe disables payments, absent email credentials select jsonTransport, and unavailable S3 fails uploads at use, despite the launch checklist's broader required configuration list (tixmoapi2/src/config/environment.ts:142-154; tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/service.ts:21-37; tixmoapi2/src/config/email.ts:135-182; tixmoapi2/src/services/upload.service.ts:29-56; docs/PRODUCTION_LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md:39-81). Auth rate-limit comment claims 5/minute, but production implementation allows 20 (tixmoapi2/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts:61-74). Custom TEAM_MEMBER permissions are documented as stored metadata, not broadly enforced route authority; scanner credentials are separate (docs/ROLE_ACTION_PERMISSION_MATRIX.md:62-78). AI/Twilio/Elasticsearch settings exist without inspected runtime consumers; they are not established external execution surfaces.

The preceding architecture model is preserved as an offline mapping. Parent read-only verification on 2026-10-04 confirms the live June 16 source revision, the production migrate+seed+start command, active API/dashboard/Postgres/Redis services, absolute frontend API URL, missing frontend Stripe/policy configuration, and absent configured backend Stripe/Sentry variables. Proxy sanitization, IAM, backup restore and authenticated user journeys remain unverified.
attackerCapabilities: Unauthenticated clients can reach public event, registration/login/refresh, review-token, asset-share-token, and webhook routes; they control request headers/body/URL within parser and rate limits (tixmoapi2/src/api/index.ts:42-63; tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/routes.ts:90,157,215; tixmoapi2/src/api/review/routes.ts:14-35; tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/routes.ts:7; tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/routes.ts:67). Customers possess their own credentials/orders; authenticated staff possess their assigned role and business authority, not unrestricted destructive/admin rights. Scanner-key holders possess scanner capability rather than user-session authority (tixmoapi2/src/middleware/authorize.ts:7-21; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/scannerAuth.ts:19-48). Reviewer/share-link holders possess intentionally delegated capabilities; ordinary forwarding within that capability is not automatically a privilege escalation. Meaningful failures could add unearned staff/admin privileges, access to another customer's data, admission authority outside assigned events, unauthorized approval/media access, or payment/inventory mutation. No assumption that attackers already control Railway/GitHub/operator accounts, process environment, signing keys, S3 credentials, private databases, or production proxies.
securityObjectives: Preserve the user-provided single-business deployment model while enforcing customer ownership, staff role/destructive-action controls, scanner event capabilities, and reviewer/share scope. Bind money and inventory changes to database-derived amounts and authenticated Stripe events; require paid orders before admission (tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/service.ts:40-65,95-101,224-249; tixmoapi2/src/api/scanners/service.ts:394-403). Keep JWT/scanner/reviewer/share credentials private across browser storage, request destinations, email, telemetry, and logs. Retain refresh revocation state in Redis and reject refresh when its state cannot be validated (tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/service.ts:208-269). Enforce configured API limits and upload limits: normal production defaults are 600 GET and 240 writes per 900000 ms, authentication 20/minute per IP, multipart 10 files at 25 MB/file, and waiting-room threshold 5000 concurrent requests (tixmoapi2/src/config/environment.ts:21-23,109-120; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts:66-98; tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/controller.ts:69-72; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/waitingRoom.ts:6-22). Keep production migrations/seeds/resets tied to an intentional database target and recoverable backups rather than assuming developer labels enforce isolation.
threatModel.summary: Tixmo combines a React/Vite browser dashboard, public checkout/review/share pages, and an Express/TypeScript API backed by Prisma/PostgreSQL and Redis. API startup connects PostgreSQL and Redis before importing Express, listening on PORT (default 3000), and starting order-expiry and approval-reminder jobs (tixmoapi2/src/index.ts:10-32). Versioned routes include staff operations, customer orders/tickets/payments, scanner operations, approval review, asset sharing, and reports (tixmoapi2/src/api/index.ts:41-66). User-provided deployment context: one business per deployment; broad authorized staff visibility within that business is not a cross-tenant boundary. Local root npm dev launches the two packages and Docker database services (package.json:7-11; scripts/dev.mjs:162-176). Frontend production uses a multi-stage Docker build and Nginx static SPA serving; API production starts dist/index.js, but production infrastructure configuration is not present in inspected source (tdash/Dockerfile:13-27; tixmoapi2/package.json:7-9).
trustBoundaries: Browser/public client -> API: Axios sends Authorization bearer tokens and refresh-token request bodies to a runtime-configured API URL; runtime config overrides build-time VITE_API_URL (tdash/src/lib/runtimeConfig.js:13-16; tdash/src/lib/api.js:11-41,56-62). Express owns bearer verification, route role gates, 10 MB parsers, Helmet, CORS, and rate-limit middleware; trusted browser origins include configured CORS_ORIGIN/CLIENT_URL plus HTTPS tixmo.co subdomains, while Origin-less clients are allowed (tixmoapi2/src/app.ts:23-63,132; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/auth.ts:28-54; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/authorize.ts:7-21; tixmoapi2/src/utils/clientOrigin.ts:18-45). Public enrollment -> staff identity: register consumes X-Forwarded-Host before Host, derives an organization seed before Railway environment fallbacks, and assigns OWNER to its first member or TEAM_MEMBER thereafter; proxy/header restrictions are external assumptions (tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/routes.ts:90; tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/controller.ts:20-26; tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/tenantOrganization.ts:90-108; tixmoapi2/src/api/auth/service.ts:36-84,99-117). Customer -> payment: authenticated creation retrieves the caller-owned order and derives the amount from database totalAmount; Stripe webhook signature verification is separate from browser authentication (tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/routes.ts:49-67; tixmoapi2/src/api/payments/service.ts:32-65,88-101). Scanner device -> admission/attendee data: separate bearer API keys authenticate an ACTIVE scanner; route-specific scanner flows must preserve event assignment and paid-ticket invariants (tixmoapi2/src/middleware/scannerAuth.ts:19-48; tixmoapi2/src/api/scanners/service.ts:134-161,394-436). Reviewer -> approval: public token routes permit reading, decisions, comments, and adding reviewers; service lookup/expiry binds the token to its approval reviewer (tixmoapi2/src/api/review/routes.ts:9-35; tixmoapi2/src/api/approvals/service.ts:1495-1510,1831-1845). Asset-share recipient -> selected folders: a distinct random bearer token is hashed for lookup, encrypted for operator retrieval, and checked for revocation/expiry (tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/routes.ts:7; tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/service.ts:60-83,729-753,813-845). API -> filesystem/S3: authenticated multipart staging writes to os.tmpdir(), then S3 uses assets/{organizationId}/{UUID}{extension} or approvals/{approvalId}/revision-{n}/{UUID}{extension}; serialized URLs delegate GET access for 24 hours independently of later API checks (tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/controller.ts:61-80; tixmoapi2/src/api/approvals/controller.ts:20-45; tixmoapi2/src/api/assets/service.ts:914-925; tixmoapi2/src/api/approvals/service.ts:452-464; tixmoapi2/src/services/upload.service.ts:59-87,112-131). API -> email/logging/telemetry: reviewer links go to reviewer email addresses through Postmark/SMTP; originalUrl is logged, and Sentry receives error/request context with only limited explicit password-field scrubbing (tixmoapi2/src/services/approval-email.service.ts:40-88; tixmoapi2/src/middleware/requestLogger.ts:4-17; tixmoapi2/src/config/sentry.ts:17-63). Operator/release tooling -> database: migration, seed, reset, and demo commands use privileged database authority outside HTTP authentication (tixmoapi2/package.json:18-27; tixmoapi2/prisma/utils/cleanup.ts:4-46).
